# Code of conduct

Almanac follows the **[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1][covenant]**.
Filing an issue, opening a pull request or commenting on one means you
agree to it.

## Reporting

If you see or experience behaviour that breaks the code, report it
privately to `tuhin@almanac.bar` with `[Almanac conduct]` in the
subject. Reports are confidential. Expect a reply within 72 hours and a
decision on next steps within a week.

## Enforcement

The maintainer enforces the code using the Covenant's
[impact guidelines][enforce], from a private word to a permanent ban,
in proportion to the behaviour.

[covenant]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
[enforce]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines
